column1: # Hmong kinship terms, from White (2021) Table 29, printed p. 288, with the
# coordinate compounds from p. 288 below the table.
# White notes the list "is likely not exhaustive".
# Kinship is where this project most needs new concepts rather than links. English
# does not lexicalise most of these distinctions, so English WordNet has no synset
# for them: there is no lemma `maternal uncle`, none for `paternal uncle older than
# father`, and none for `brother of a female`. A Hmong wordnet must either propose
# the concepts to the interlingual index or lose the distinctions the language
# obligatorily makes. The ILI_STATUS column says which is which.
# This table is also the best source of Green Mong content vocabulary we have:
# White gives a distinct GM form for eleven of these, where the classifier tables
# gave us almost no GM nouns at all.
#   GM            the Green Mong form, where White gives a distinct one; empty
#                 means he gives one form for both.
#   GLOSS         his gloss, split into one row per sense where he gives two.
#   RELATION      consanguineal, affinal, or compound (the coordinate compounds).
#   ILI_STATUS    `lemma` if the gloss is an English WordNet lemma, so an existing
#                 concept; `propose` if it is not, so a candidate for a new ILI.
#                 Filled by measurement, not by hand -- see the README.
